classification: public UI regression capture before restore/instance-selector implementation

steps: Opened the pristine root page in a fresh named browser session.
Clicked the public Sofle v2 copy action and confirmed the editor opened on Left PCB.
Verified a saved project record exists in the isolated projects store: id m1-sofle-v2-copy, name Sofle v2, revision 3, with two hardware instances (left and right).
Reloaded the page. The snapshot showed only the Keyboard library and its saved Sofle v2 row; there was no Keyboard editor, selected board, component list, or Case assembly region.
Opened the saved Sofle v2 row manually to confirm that the persisted project still opens through the library action.
Reloaded again with browser offline mode enabled. The service worker controlled the offline reload, but startup still showed only the library and saved row.

physicalInstanceSelectorRed.consequence: Current UI selects a board, not one of the saved physical instances; physical-instance scoped case settings/generation cannot be reached from this public UI.

scopeLimit: This is a pre-fix red capture of root-prefix cold startup and missing physical-instance selection. It does not test physical-instance transitions, active-editor restore green behavior, pending job cancellation, or subpath restore.
